items.title: Slide Hampton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We played together for a while, beside the recording.

ctx.x: Tadd Dameron. The Continuum group. Whose idea was that? What was the life of that project? Was it just a recording? How did that – talk about how that came about.
We played together for a while, beside the recording. I’m trying to think who was the one that got the idea of that together, because we had – it was Ron Carter, and – Arthur Taylor?
I think. I know, Kenny Barron.
